Inspect source/provenance/license first; video root LICENSE absent is not automatic MIT and not proof of no rights. If reuse cannot be cleared, return concrete gap/ready alternative for director/company decision, do not invent engine.

Permission scope: own workspace first; task explicitly authorizes necessary minimal kit/adjacent caption adapter changes via isolated branch/worktree, preserve siblings/unrelated files, source inputs read-only. Do not modify voice/media assets or company account/settings. Ready code should accept word{id,text,t0,t1,audit}, page{visible_t0/t1,word_ids,lines,pixel_width,CPS,semantic_word_ids}. Full speech, stable phrase-page, ONLY active word highlight and semantic accent same layer; <=2 lines/42chars AND pixel-fit, target15/max17CPS, safe>=6%side/12%bottom plus actual UI masks, zero overlaps/echo. Final audio SHA linked; ASR hints corrected/forced-aligned then audited. Internal V8 take timing reference is not external/commercial voice clearance; no upload or new voice cloning here.

Acceptance G0-T: exercise on actual content, not stub. Working caption stress-probe for legacy violation windows1.66-2.94,11.55-13.19,20.44-22.00,38.12-38.98,43.37-44.83 (31cue,5>17,max21.094; raw ASR105tokens first издаешь, missing места). Real S01/S05/S06 component demos from direction data. Deterministic frame-seek equality, offline fonts/assets/no random-network; export/labels survive; 320x568/360x640/390x844/720x1280+master UI-mask tests and complete word coverage. Re-paging actual voice, no text deletion/uniform interpolation to cheat. Working artifacts/screenshots+SHA+commands+real test output+licenses/provenance/transitive lock. Distinguish tech test pass from independent viewer/media QA. Request independent review for this code/probe before done; escalate unretrievable capability honestly.

Next owner company/video-editor only after G0-T evidence AND separate G1/G2 company card cleared. Do not render/publish final V9 and do not self-score9-10. Read parent final concept verdict before action.
